Group rides in South Carolina

15 recurring group rides around South Carolina: 13 road, 3 social, 1 gravel. 7 roll on weeknights, 7 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Rock Hill Bicycle Club Slow Spokes in Rock Hill — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Saturday Store Ride (Trek Charleston) runs a and B 19–21 mph, C 16–18, D 13–15.
